name: IBA International Business Academy
about: IBA is a business academy based at Havneparken in central Kolding, with teaching built around company cases and projects. The BA (Hons) International Business Management listed here is delivered entirely online and awarded by Leeds Beckett University; students can study from any location.

notes: This page currently lists the confirmed first-year online BA only. It is not an exhaustive 2027 portfolio: the on-campus Coventry BSc has conflicting upper-secondary/AP documentation requirements; Business Management across Europe still publishes 2026 dates; Euro-Asia/AP English-only completion needs confirmation.

The online BA is a Leeds Beckett University award delivered through IBA, entirely online with no required travel to Kolding or Danish student-visa entitlement. Tuition is DKK 155,000 for the whole degree for every citizenship group, plus DKK 750 application fee and service charge unless exempt as an IBA graduate. It has no SU or IBA scholarship.

IB Diploma and DP Course Results entry treatment for this Leeds Beckett route must be confirmed individually. The 24-point IB guidance published for IBA Coventry courses does not establish a threshold for this BA.

The online BA page requires TOEFL iBT 79 with 19 in every section; its application form lists 65. Agree which proof applies before relying on either number. English-medium exemptions are subject to Leeds Beckett regulations.

Predicted-grade format, final IB-results delivery and any separate final-document, reply or offer-acceptance deadline are not published. Applicants still studying provide detailed transcripts and their expected graduation date; arrange final-results handling with IBA before applying.

programmes.name: BA (Hons) International Business Management
programmes.description: The programme progresses through Certificate, Diploma and Bachelor stages. It covers business organisation, digital business, economics, financial management, marketing and human resources, ending with independent research.

structure.teachingStyle: Entirely online: mainly asynchronous Canvas discussion, supported by webinars and lecturer feedback.
structure.assessment: Teaching and examinations take place online, with a final research project.
structure.flexibility: Full-time over three years or a flexible part-time pace over up to six years; each level is completed before progressing to the next.

programmes.about: An entirely online business and management degree awarded by Leeds Beckett University and delivered through IBA, over 3–6 years. Study from any location through asynchronous work and webinars; no travel to Denmark is required. Tuition is DKK 155,000 for the full degree, regardless of citizenship; a separate application fee and books are additional.

language.note: Entirely online English-language degree; students may study from any geographical location.

requirements.label: An upper-secondary qualification accepted as equivalent to UK Level 3; IBA assesses qualifications individually.
requirements.note: For applicants from Denmark the programme names STX, HHX, HTX, HF or equivalent; applicants from other countries need a qualification giving higher-education access at home and accepted as UK Level 3 equivalent. No programme-specific subject requirements are published. Coventry-course IB 24-point guidance is not imported into this LBU route.

requirements.note: Applicants from Denmark need Danish English B equivalence. The programme lists IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79 with at least 19 per section, CAE A/B/C or Oxford B2 with at least 70 per part.
